overview:
Brazil, the winningest team in World Cup history, kicks off its bid for a sixth title this Saturday against Morocco. The match marks the first World Cup game in the New York-New Jersey metropolitan area, and it kicks off inside MetLife Stadium at 9 p.m. ET on FS1. Brazil last won the World Cup in 2002 (and also took home the trophy when the tournament was held in the U.S. in 1994). Morocco returns to the tournament having placed fourth in 2022.
